labels.meta_glasses_instructions:
1. In Meta View: Settings → Save to Camera Roll = ON.
2. Grant SmartPlay access to Photos.
3. Say "Hey Meta, take a photo" on course. Tank will auto-detect it.

settings.glasses_mode_desc: Use Ray-Ban Meta for hands-free Tank
settings.glasses_tutorial_body:
Quick setup:

1. Pair Ray-Ban Meta in iPhone Bluetooth
2. iPhone Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Call Audio Routing → Bluetooth Headset
3. Keep SmartPlay open in background
4. Say "Hey Meta" then ask Tank

Tank will respond in your glasses.
settings.glasses_how_to_body:
1. Phone in pocket, SmartPlay open
2. Say "Hey Meta" to glasses
3. Ask: "Tank, driver or 3-wood?"
4. Hear the answer in your glasses

text.four_caddies_one_team_each: Four caddies, one team. Each part of your game can have a different caddie. We've set sensible defaults — change anything anytime.
text.when_a_teammate_is_better: When a teammate is better suited, your active caddie can suggest a handoff. "Card only" shows the visual offer without a voice line. "Off" disables suggestions entirely.
text.top_left_badge_during_a: Top-left badge during a round showing live accuracy + GPS mode + outlier count. Use during the Garmin comparison test.
text.manually_override_the_active_caddie: Manually override the active caddie (the team auto-selects per pillar — this picks who speaks right now).
text.changes_your_caddie_s_voice: Changes your caddie's voice + responses now. On-screen text is still being translated and stays in English for the moment.
text.tap_your_earbud_or_bt: Tap your earbud (or BT remote) button anytime — even from the home screen — and the caddie starts listening. Works hands-free without opening anything. Turn off only if it interferes with pausing music.
text.2026_09_01_tim_temple: 2026-09-01 (Tim: "temple tap on meta glasses is working", and "yes they do have an SDK and we have it already") — this row said BLOCKED because Meta exposed no SDK. Wrong on both halves. Meta ships the Device Access Toolkit and it is INTEGRATED here (MetaWearablesFrameModule + metaWearablesBridge, POV frames into the caddie brain); it needs the glasses build profile, not permission from Meta. And the temple tap does not depend on it at all: the glasses pair as a Bluetooth audio device, so a tap arrives as an ordinary media-key press and the earbud bridge already handles it, which is why it works today. Controlled by the earbud tap-to-talk switch above.-mic + Active Listening is the path: pair the glasses for Bluetooth audio and the caddie hears you hands-free.
text.pick_your_smartpump_workout_export: Pick your SmartPump workout export (PDF, image, or JSON/CSV). We read the dated golf workouts and chart your TRAINING → PERFORMANCE on the dashboard — whether the gym work is showing up in your scoring. Re-import any time; we skip duplicates.
text.reads_step_count_heart_rate: Reads step count, heart rate, distance walked, and active calories during your round (Galaxy Watch, Fitbit, or phone pedometer via Android Health Connect). Used for the walking-vs-cart detector, automatic shot detection, and round-summary stats. All data stays on your phone unless you opt into backend sync. Android only today; iOS / HealthKit comes later.
text.tap_to_grant_smartplay_read: Tap to grant SmartPlay read access to your Health Connect data (steps, heart rate, distance, calories). Required for the walking-vs-cart detector to use real step counts. If you skip this, cart/walk detection still works using GPS + your manual Cart Mode toggle.
text.what_we_send_for_ai: What we send for AI coaching
text.when_you_talk_to_your: When you talk to your caddie, we send your message plus your first name, handicap, and (if set) GHIN to the AI service that powers the coaching, so the advice is personalized. We send your GPS location to a weather service to factor wind and temperature into yardages. We don’t sell your data.
text.your_rounds_scores_swing_clips: Your rounds, scores, swing clips, bag distances, and profile live on this device. Your GHIN number is kept in memory for the session only — it isn’t written to disk — until encrypted-at-rest storage ships.
text.coach_refinements_saved_via_remember: Coach refinements saved via "remember this" voice trigger. Per-entry + bulk export to support@smartplaycaddie.com.
text.fires_one_real_error_into: Fires one real error into Sentry so you can confirm error alerts still reach you. Nothing breaks.
text.field_tests_and_ship_steps: Field tests and ship steps, ticked off as you go. Reminds you on launch, and the caddie will read it out — "what's on my checklist".
text.your_digital_business_card_qr: Your digital business card — QR to the download, tap to call, email or share. Ask the caddie for "my card".
text.capture_example_photos_narrative_for: Capture example photos + narrative for fault references (open face, over-the-top, etc.) that train the analysis.
text.logged_issues_voice_log_this: Logged issues (voice "log this: …" + manual). Owner Claude-triage + export inside.
text.17_scenarios_9_critical_5: 17 scenarios (9 critical + 5 high-value + 3 nice-to-have) — exercises real stores via the production voice router.
text.phrasings_that_didn_t_match: Phrasings that didn't match a handler. Field testing surfaces the gaps here for review.
text.voice_narrated_practice_round_on: Voice-narrated practice round on simulated GPS. Say "start a sim round" works too. Never touches your handicap or learned data.
text.plays_a_full_round_by: Plays a full round by itself — no voice — using your learned club distances and miss tendency. Watches hole advance, scoring and yardages, then exports the report. Never touches your handicap or learned data.
text.curate_upload_instruction_videos_for: Curate + upload instruction videos for the tutorial library.
text.last_swing_frames_sent_vs: Last swing: frames sent vs. server image blocks. PASS proves the multi-frame pipe end-to-end.
text.replay_every_feature_s_3: Replay every feature's 3-line first-run tutorial on next entry. Owner test path.
text.drop_an_anchor_at_your: Drop an anchor at your current position, walk, watch the yards tick. Use this in a parking lot to verify GPS independent of course geometry.
text.on_device_module_status_the: On-device module status + the capture-engine A/B flag lives here.
text.debug_hub_captured_swing_tuples: Debug hub — captured swing tuples + links to the other debug screens.
text.subscription_trial_state_the_30: Subscription + trial state, the 30-day promotion, and Force Paywall (for the App Store review screenshot).
text.walk_to_a_tee_box: Walk to a tee box OR green center and capture its real GPS coords. Toggle inside picks which one. Fixes yardages for any hole shipping with placeholder data.
text.clear_your_profile_rounds_settings: Clear your profile, rounds, settings, and saved swings. Use this to start fresh.

text.trail_wrist_your_release_side: Trail wrist (your release side) — best for spotting casting / early release. Club speed is a rougher estimate from here.
text.lead_wrist_default_the_steering: Lead wrist (default) — the steering side, cleaner club-speed read. Toggle on if you wear the watch on your trail arm to target release faults.

alert.choose_a_passphrase_of_at: Choose a passphrase of at least 4 characters. You’ll need the SAME email + passphrase to restore on another phone.
alert.your_data_is_saved_to: Your data is saved to your account. It’ll auto-back-up from now on. Keep your email + passphrase to restore on a new phone.

cloud_backup_card.save_a_backup_file_of: Save a backup file of your rounds, bag, caddie memory, courses + settings. Keep it in Files / Drive / email — restore it any time, even on a new phone. No account needed.
cloud_backup_card.pick_a_backup_id_your: Pick a Backup ID (your email) and a passphrase. Your data auto-backs-up and restores on ANY phone with the same pair — that’s what makes a new phone pick up right where you left off. The email alone won’t unlock your data without the passphrase, so keep the passphrase somewhere safe — we can’t recover it.

course_map.set_your_target_effort_on: Set your target effort on the capture screen, then record a down-the-line swing — your shot plots here from the effort estimate and the ball-trace start direction.
course_map.estimated_from_your_club_effort: Estimated from your club × effort and the acoustic-anchored trace. Refines as your real carry data builds.

cage_bullseye.lateral_start_comes_from_the: Lateral start comes from the acoustic-anchored trace; depth + height on the bullseye sharpen with higher-frame-rate capture. Line the rings up over your net's bullseye.
